groups.saying_opens: كل من خالف سفيان فالقول قول سفيان

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad (rule 4a): Shu'ba's reply «دمغتني» and Yahya ibn Ma'in's «كل من خالف سفيان»
Saying 1: the father is a bare relation; Shu'ba speaks inside the story, so he is the last link (narrated encounter). The man who said «خالفك سفيان» is in the scene only
Saying 2 opens with «بلغني»: an unnamed transmitter (rule 8)
